integrity: The classification premise was checked in the full Tóth--Waldhauser article; the new formulas were proved directly and independently brute-force checked on six small lattices, including nondistributive examples.
scientific_limitations: Counts binary-meet homomorphisms and embeddings into Boolean meet-semilattices only; no nullary constants are named. The enumeration is an elementary refinement of standard finite-lattice representation facts and may have folklore antecedents.
title: Exact Boolean-target morphism profiles of finite polymorphism-homogeneous semilattices
